blocks.text: Biomedical science (tibbi science) mein masnoo aaza (artificial organs) banane ke liye polymers bohat ahem hain. Masnoo aaza insan ke banaye hue aalaat hain jo jism ke kharab ya bimar hisson ki jagah lete hain ya un ke kaam mein madad dete hain. Jism mein lagne wale polymers ko biocompatible (jism ke saath mutabiqat rakhne wale), mechanically munasib, sterilizable (jaraseem se paak kiye ja sakne wale), durable (der tak chalne wale) aur tunable (zaroorat ke mutabiq badle ja sakne wale) hona chahiye.
Yeh jism ko nuqsan na dein, allergy paida na karein, aur jism ka immune system (bimariyon se bachane wala nizam) inhein radd (reject) na kare.

In ki mazbooti, lachak (flexibility) ya elasticity us hisse ke mutabiq badli ja sakti hai jis ki jagah yeh lagte hain (maslan khoon ki naliyon ke liye lachakdar, haddiyon ke liye mazboot). Tibb mein mukhtalif polymers ke istemal Table 26.2 mein diye gaye hain.

blocks.caption: Table 26.2 Masnoo (artificial) aaza mein polymers
rows: Hamwar satah khoon jamne (clot) se rokti hai; band naliyon ki jagah lagti hain ya un ke gird raasta (bypass) banati hain.
Bohat lachakdar aur der tak chalne wale; khoon jamne se mehfooz hone chahiye.
Nayi jild ugne ke liye dhaancha (scaffold); kuch zakhm bharne ke saath ghul jate hain.
Hamwar, kam friction wali satah jo harkat aasan banaye aur ghisaav bardasht kare.
Bilkul shaffaf (transparent) aur biocompatible, taa ke nazar bahal ho.

blocks.prompt: PTFE masnoo khoon ki naliyon ke liye kyun munasib hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh biocompatible hai aur is ki hamwar satah khoon jamne (clot) se rokti hai.

items: Tibbi polymers: biocompatible, munasib mazbooti, sterilizable, durable aur tunable.
PTFE/PET naliyan, polyurethane/silicone valves, collagen/PLA jild, UHMWPE jor, PMMA cornea.
